common.demoBadgeLabel: This app is a demo by KHENOV and all of its data is fictional

slide1.title: Book your class in seconds
slide1.body: A clear weekly schedule, one-tap booking and a waitlist when a class is full.

slide2.title: Log every exercise, every set
slide2.body: Start a session, log weights and reps, and let the rest timer do the counting.

slide3.title: Watch your progress climb
slide3.body: Personal records, charts for your weight and measurements, and a streak that keeps you going.

login.title: Welcome to Nabd
login.subtitle: Try the complete member journey: booking, training, progress and membership.
login.note: No real sign-in. All data is fictional and stays on your device.

home.streakHint: Keep it going with a workout or class today

today.title: Today's plan
today.restBody: Recovery is part of progress. Take it easy today or book a light class.

next.title: Next class
next.emptyBody: Book your first class and start an active week.

profile.title: Profile
profile.demoNote: All data in this app is fictional and stays on your device.
profile.resetHint: Clears your demo data and takes you back to the start
profile.resetConfirmBody: The bookings, workouts and measurements you added will be erased and you will return to the start screen.
profile.settingsNote: Simulated. These choices decide which notifications reach your inbox.
profile.settingsFailed: We couldn't save that setting. Try again.
profile.aboutBody: Nabd is a demo gym app made by KHENOV, a bilingual digital studio. Every member, trainer, class and number in it is fictional.

error.title: Couldn't load
error.body: Something went wrong while loading your data. Check your connection and try again.

classes.title: Classes
classes.subtitle: Book your spot in this week's classes

empty.dayBody: Pick another day of the week.
empty.filteredBody: Try changing the filters or picking another day.

note.booked: Your spot is booked. You can cancel up to two hours before the class starts.
note.bookedLocked: Your spot is booked. The cancellation window closed two hours before the class.
note.full: This class is full. Join the waitlist and we will confirm the first spot that opens.
note.waitlisted: You are on the waitlist. When a spot opens your booking is confirmed automatically and we will let you know.
note.open: Booking is included in your membership.
note.ended: Pick an upcoming class from the schedule.

notFound.title: We couldn't find this class
notFound.body: It may no longer be listed. Browse the schedule and pick another time.

success.title: Your booking is confirmed
success.body: See you in class! Here is your booking summary.

toast.waitlistJoined: You are on the waitlist. Your spot is {{positionText}}
toast.promoted: A spot opened up! You're confirmed for {{name}}

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

booking.in_past: This class has already started or ended.
booking.already_booked: You are already booked into this class.
booking.already_waitlisted: You are already on the waitlist.
booking.class_full: This class is full. You can join the waitlist.
booking.class_not_full: There are spots available. You can book directly.
booking.overlap: You have another booking that clashes with this class.
booking.not_booked: There is no booking to cancel.
booking.not_waitlisted: You are not on the waitlist.
booking.cutoff_passed: Bookings can't be cancelled less than two hours before the class.

workout.invalid_weight: Weight must be between 0 and 500 kg.
workout.invalid_reps: Reps must be a whole number from 1 to 100.
workout.invalid_set_count: This action isn't possible for this set.
workout.no_sets: Log at least one set before saving.
workout.no_active_session: There is no session in progress.
workout.session_in_progress: You already have a session in progress. Finish or discard it first.

body.invalid_weightKg: Weight must be between 30 and 300 kg.
body.invalid_waistCm: Waist must be between 40 and 250 cm.
body.invalid_chestCm: Chest must be between 50 and 250 cm.
body.invalid_armCm: Arm must be between 15 and 80 cm.

membership.invalid_card_number: Check the card number. The demo card is 4242 4242 4242 4242.
membership.invalid_card_expiry: Enter a valid expiry date in the future, as MM/YY.
membership.invalid_wallet_phone: Enter an Egyptian mobile number, like 01012345678.
membership.card_declined: This card was declined. Try the demo card or another method.
membership.payment_failed: The payment service is not responding. You were not charged. Try again.

visit.membership_expired: Your membership has ended. Renew to check in.
visit.duplicate_scan: You already checked in a moment ago.

profile.invalid_name_ar: Enter the Arabic name with 2 to 40 characters, without numbers or symbols.
profile.invalid_name_en: Enter the English name with 2 to 40 characters, without numbers or symbols.
profile.invalid_initials: Use one or two letters, with no numbers or spaces.

workout.title: Workout
workout.subtitle: Pick your plan and start a session

today.title: Today's workout
today.restBody: You can still pick any plan and start a session whenever you like.

planDetail.title: Plan details
planDetail.blocked: You have a session in progress. Finish or discard it first.
planDetail.notFoundBody: Go back to Workout and pick another plan.

resume.title: Session in progress
resume.discardBody: The sets you logged will not be saved.

recent.title: Recent sessions
recent.emptyBody: Start your first session and it will show up here.

library.openBody: Browse exercises, search and filter by muscle
library.title: Exercise library
library.emptyBody: Try another word or a different muscle group.

exercise.title: Exercise
exercise.emptyTitle: You haven't logged this exercise yet
exercise.emptyBody: The first session that includes it will appear here.
exercise.notFoundBody: Go back to the library and pick another one.

session.title: Session
session.noLast: First time you do this exercise
session.allDone: You finished every set of this exercise

rest.title: Rest
rest.over: Rest is over. Ready for the next set!

quit.title: End the session?
quit.body: You haven't finished every planned set. You can save what you did or discard the session.
quit.noSets: You haven't logged any set yet, so there is nothing to save.

session.emptyBody: Start a session from the Workout tab.

summary.title: Session summary
summary.greatBody: You finished your session and it is saved in your history.
summary.partialBody: We saved what you did. You can finish the rest next time.
summary.noPrs: No records this time, but you are building strength session by session.
summary.notFoundBody: It may have been removed by resetting the demo.

progress.title: Your progress
progress.subtitle: Your weight, measurements and personal records

weight.title: Weight
weight.emptyBody: Log your first weight to start charting your progress.
weight.noneInRange: No measurements in this period. Choose a longer one.

volume.title: Weekly training volume
volume.subtitle: Total weight lifted each week
volume.emptyBody: Complete a session and its volume will show here.
volume.axisUnit: The axis is in tons; the tooltip shows kilograms.

chart.trendFlat: About the same over the period
chart.hint: Touch the chart to see values

records.title: Personal records
records.emptyBody: Complete sessions and your best set for each exercise will show here.

membership.title: Membership
membership.expiredBody: Renew to book classes and use the gym again. Your new period starts today.
membership.expiringBody: Renew now and the new period continues right after this one, with no gap.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.mockBanner: Demo checkout. No real payment is made. Please do not enter real card details.
checkout.cardHint: Demo card already filled in. 4000 0000 0000 0002 simulates a decline.
checkout.walletHint: Any Egyptian mobile number works, like 01012345678.
checkout.successBody: Your membership is renewed. Enjoy your training.

pass.title: Check-in pass

pass.simulateBody: Demo only. Pretend you scanned your pass at the gym door.
pass.emptyBody: Tap "Simulate scan" to record your first visit.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.emptyBody: Class reminders, waitlist news, badges and payments will show up here.

waitlist.title: You got a spot

editProfile.title: Edit profile
editProfile.initialsHint: One or two letters. Leave empty to make them from your name.
